faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: RinKuzu offers a free plan with all basic features like quiz creation, flashcards, and review. We also have a Premium plan for users who want unlimited access and advanced AI features.
faq.q2: How to create a quiz from a PDF?
faq.a2: Simply upload your lecture PDF, and our AI will automatically analyze the content and suggest relevant multiple-choice or essay questions.
faq.q3: Can I share my quiz sets?
faq.a3: Of course! You can set your quizzes to public to share with friends or the learning community on RinKuzu.
faq.a4: Rin-chan uses large language models to understand your lesson content and can explain difficult concepts, suggesting solutions in an easy-to-understand way.
